title: The Constitutional Right to Travel (without a License)& Case Law to support it!
summary: Right-to-travel promoter reads case-law excerpts and a traffic-stop script advising drivers to withhold license, registration and insurance.

assertions.quote: higher courts have ruled that american citizens have a right to travel without state permits
american citizens do indeed have the inalienable right to use the roadways unrestricted in any manner
we're not engaged in transportation we're not commercial therefore his authority to pull us over for some alleged offense under that code is non-existent
that means you don't give him a license you don't give him registration you don't give him proof of insurance

verdicts.note: Every state requires a driver to produce a license on a lawful stop; refusal is itself an offence and often leads to arrest.
Ohio R.C. 4507.35 requires an operator to display the license or proof on a peace officer's demand; refusal led to an affirmed conviction.

assertions.quote: every time you are stopped for an alleged transportation stop you are already in a custodial arrest

verdicts.note: Berkemer v. McCarty held that routine traffic stops are not custodial for Miranda purposes.

assertions.quote: many law enforcement personnel may be unaware of the contractual nature of auto registration and driver's license
